title: Show HN: Vett – Scan, sign, and verify AI agent skills before installing
description: Security registry for AI agent skills. Scanned 5k skills, found critical risks like base64-obfuscated droppers and exfiltration scripts in 'React Native Best Practices' skill. Highlights that skills are currently unsigned binaries pulled at HEAD.

title: Show HN: G0 – The control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
description: Unified control layer for AI agents. Includes 'g0 scan' for static/behavioral analysis, 'g0 test' for red teaming, and 'g0 daemon' for continuous runtime monitoring and kill switches. Explicitly supports OpenClaw architecture.

title: Thenvoi launches platform to help developers orchestrate multiple AI coding agents
description: Platform for orchestrating multiple AI coding agents, highlighting the move towards multi-agent engineering workflows.

title: Show HN: DevOpsAgents – AI agents to deploy and manage your infra

title: Show HN: Gazill – Save your code, it's live. Built for vibe coders and agents
